name: spinner-packs
description: Themed spinner words: Claude is 'Plundering…' then 'Plundered for 1m 3s'. Ten packs (pirate, Shakespeare, corporate, wizard, chef, space, noir, Gen Z, zen, retro) or your own words.

pack.title: Word pack
pack.description: Which words the spinner uses. random picks a pack each session; off keeps Claude Code's own.

custom.title: Custom words
custom.description: Comma-separated words that replace every pack, e.g. 'Frobbing|Frobbed, Yak shaving|Shaved yaks'. The part after | themes the line that closes a turn.

themeClosingLine.title: Theme the closing line
themeClosingLine.description: Also theme the line that closes a turn ('Plundered for 1m 3s'). Terminal only.
